units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:2">Peah VI, 2</cite> <he>סמוך לג׳ ולגדיש</he> (Ms. M. <he>לגפא ולגדר</he>, Ar. <he>לגפא</he>) near the stone fence (ready for being carried out) or the stack; <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 4:4">Eduy. IV, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 115:2">Sifré Num. 115</cite> <he>ג׳ של ר׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="C01202"><he>גפי</he></cite>) by the Capitol of Rome (an invocation used by a gentile woman).
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:6">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ של פרס</he> (read <cite ref="T00390"><he>רומי</he></cite>, Ar. <he>גפא דרומי</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 87b:19">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דרומאי</he> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="D01060"><he>דרומי</he></cite>, omitted in some ed.).
